SELECT s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip,
       SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(d2.d_date_sk, d1.d_date_sk) <= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "30 days",
       SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(d2.d_date_sk, d1.d_date_sk) > 30 AND DATEDIFF(d2.d_date_sk, d1.d_date_sk) <= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "31-60 days",
       SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(d2.d_date_sk, d1.d_date_sk) > 60 AND DATEDIFF(d2.d_date_sk, d1.d_date_sk) <= 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "61-90 days",
       SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(d2.d_date_sk, d1.d_date_sk) > 90 AND DATEDIFF(d2.d_date_sk, d1.d_date_sk) <= 120 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "91-120 days",
       SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(d2.d_date_sk, d1.d_date_sk) > 120 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ">120 days"
FROM store s
JOIN (
    SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2001 AND d_moy BETWEEN 5 AND 8
) d1 ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
JOIN (
    SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2001 AND d_moy = 8
) d2 ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
JOIN store_sales ss ON s.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk AND ss.ss_sold_date_sk BETWEEN (SELECT MIN(d_date_sk) FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2001 AND d_moy BETWEEN 5 AND 8) AND (SELECT MAX(d_date_sk) FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2001 AND d_moy BETWEEN 5 AND 8)
JOIN store_returns sr ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number AND ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
WHERE ss_customer_sk = sr.sr_customer_sk
GROUP BY s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip
ORDER BY s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip
LIMIT 100
